signal_actions.name: Start
signal_actions.description: Start the 1.0.73 release using compiled defaults or cap_init/trading_amount/min_tp_percent/strategy/trade_mode/tp_control overrides. Strategy selection applies when Start is received. Stairs preserves the current entry logic; MRC Reclaim uses learned MRC line transitions with single-order execution and adjacent-line TP/SL.

params.name: Initial budget %
params.description: Percent of max_amount reserved for the internal trading budget.

params.name: Trading amount %
params.description: Normal entry size as a percent of the deployable budget. Clamped to 10-100.

params.name: Minimum TP %
params.description: Minimum structural TP distance. The larger of this value and the cascade average is used.

params.name: Strategy
params.description: Choose the existing Stairs strategy or MRC Reclaim. The selection takes effect on Start; MRC Reclaim requires Single trade mode.

params.name: Trade mode
params.description: Choose single-order execution or martingale ladder execution.

params.name: TP control
params.description: Normal keeps the current TP behavior. Trailing stop uses only a favorable-only virtual SL and places a recovery TP two ticks beyond price after the SL is crossed.
